hooks.name: Pre-Push Verification Rules
hooks.description: Injects pre-push verification rules at the start of every session

action.prompt:
**MANDATORY PRE-PUSH CHECKS:** Before running `git push` on ANY repository, you MUST first run the appropriate verification:

- **Java projects (Maven):** Run `mvn spotless:apply -B && mvn spotless:check -B` in the project directory. If spotless:check fails, fix the issues before pushing.
- **Next.js/TypeScript projects:** Run `npm run lint` in the project directory. If there are errors, fix them before pushing.

Never push without passing these checks first.
